claims.claim: A blue electronic piano with all blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a blue plastic toy panel with cartoon graphics and black button/slots, but no readable brand/model and no proof of audio playback or preloaded songs.
Photos show a learning-toy style button panel, but the report does not confirm the specific content (Do re mi) or any working mode.

risks.risk: Not actually electronic/working (no confirmation of sound/lights/volume from the photos)
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on with lights/sound and pressing multiple buttons to demonstrate audio output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working/untested learning toy (worst case).

risks.risk: Battery compartment issues or missing batteries (corrosion, wrong battery type, loose contacts)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the battery compartment open/closed and a clip showing it running on the seller’s batteries (or with a new battery pack).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery-dependent and potentially requiring batteries/repairs.

risks.risk: Missing parts or non-functional buttons/slots (some buttons may be stuck or broken)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of all buttons/slots plus a clip pressing each one and showing response (sound/light).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly incomplete or with some non-working controls.

risks.risk: Unknown brand/model and age; label text not readable (affects parts availability and value)
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the label area with readable brand/model text (or the exact model number).

risks.risk: Wear/damage not fully visible (cracks, loose screws, broken hinges/handles)
risks.proof: A full set of photos from multiple angles showing the handle/arm, front buttons, and any cracks; include a close-up of screw holes/points and edges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having unknown wear beyond what’s visible.

proof_requests: Send a video showing the toy turning on and playing sounds/lights when buttons are pressed (include volume control if any).
Show the battery compartment (open and closed) and confirm battery type; include a running clip using the batteries provided.
Provide close-ups of every button/slot and a clip testing each one for response.
Send a clear, readable photo of the label area (brand/model text).
Send photos of the toy’s edges/underside/handle area to check for cracks or missing parts.
response.reason: The witness report supports that it is a children’s learning/electronic-style plastic toy panel with buttons, but the photos do not verify it is working or the exact song/piano features. I can price it at the worst case as an untested/possibly non-working generic learning toy, pending the proof requests.
